dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Why does that cat always like to run this way? Strange...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. I just brought a naughty little kitten back to its home.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It's a real lively kitty. If it gets even the slightest chance to run outside, then it'll run all over Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Knocking over flower pots, getting dirty pawprints on clothes, and keeping every pigeon in Mondstadt on their toes!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Lots of citizens just can't put up with it anymore, and some went to the Adventurers' Guild for help. But Adventurers don't know the first thing about catching cats, so...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's the Outrider to the rescue?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Bingo! Those adventurers just chase after cats on foot. But as for me... Hehe, I fly!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: A surprise air assault when it's least expected, and bam! The cat goes right into the bag!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Though... It's kind of funny how that cat never gets mad at me. Instead, whenever I catch it, it all but pounces into my arms and won't stop rubbing against me.

choices.text: It's because it likes you, isn't it?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: You think so? Hmm, in that case, I should find an opportunity to ask Diona about what cats like and what calms them down.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But before that... *sigh* I just hope it'll stop running away. Otherwise, I'll be up in the dead of night playing hide-and-seek with it again.

choices.text: Maybe it wants to have a bit more fun.
